channel.title: UKCRC Tissue Directory and Coordination Centre - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UKCRC Tissue Directory and Coordination Centre (biobankinguk.org)

item.title: Public Involvement in a Pandemic - UKCRC TDCC
item.description: Find out about the HRA's latest report on public involvement in a pandemic! We listened in to their launch session on the 13th January 2021.

item.title: Supporting Researchers with Governance in Biobanking - UKCRC TDCC
item.description: We outline findings from a recent report by the MRC Regulatory Support centre on governance in Biobanking including tissue and data access.

item.title: The TDCC Fireside chat series - UKCRC TDCC
item.description: The UKCRC TDCC are hosting a series of informal meet-ups for biobankers to discuss topics and network. Log in to say hi and exchange tips.

item.title: Smart data sharing with the TDCC - The UKCRC TDCC
item.description: Find out about how the TDCC is making data upload easier using the new TDCC submission API! Read on to find out how you can get involved.

item.title: Publications citing sample use featured on Tissue Directory Profiles
item.description: Tissue Directory profiles now feature relevant publications citing sample use. Find out more about how to enable this feature on your profile

item.title: Open Life Science - UKCRC Tissue Directory and Coordination Centre
item.description: There is a lot of talk about being open in research nowadays - but what does it mean and how does it affect you? Find out more about the Open Life Science programme.

item.title: UK Biobanking Showcase 2022 - The UKCRC TDCC
item.description: UK Biobanking Showcase 2022 is the UK's leading event for biobanks, researchers, patients and those interested in the use of human samples in research.

item.title: The Future of UK Biobanking Coordination - UKCRC Tissue Directory and Coordination Centre
item.description: The UKCRC TDCC has been undertaking a review of UK biobanking, to help shape a vision for the future. Find out more and have your say!

item.title: Bringing science to parliamentarians
item.description: Emma Lawrence secured a secondment with cross-party think tank Policy Connect. Read more about her experience with policy engagement.

item.title: A qualification for biobankers: the ISBER and ASCP BOC Qualification in Biorepository Science - UKCRC Tissue Directory and Coordination Centre
item.description: Two leading bioscience organisations have developed a new professional qualification for biobankers around the world. Read on to find out more about the QBRS.
